violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED ON THE COUNTER: COFFEE TOPPING CREAM (W/EGG & MILK) AT 75F (5HR), GARLIC TOPPING (W/EGG & MILK) AT 76F (5HR), ALMOND CREAM (W/EGG & MILK) AT 75F (5HR) IN (8): MIXED BERRY CAKE (W/HOMEMADE WHIPPING CREAM TOPPING) AT 46F (OVERNIGHT) IN (9): PEPPERONI PIZZETTA AT 47F (3HR), PESTO CHICKEN PIZETTA AT 45F (3HR), SMOKED SAUSAGE BREAD AT 45F (3HR) IN (10): EGG SALAD SANDWICH AT 51F (3HR), TURKEY PASTRY AT 54F (3HR)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: ITEMS ON COUNTER DISPOSED OF. ITEMS IN (8) WERE REMOVED FROM SERVICE TO THE PUBLIC. ITEMS IN (9) WERE CHOSEN TO BE DISPOSED OF. ITEMS IN (10) WERE MOVED TO WIF TO RAPID COOL.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: OBSERVED TCS ALMOND CREAM MADE WITH EGGS AND MILK ONSITE AND HAD EXPIRED 07/24/2026.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CDI: ALL EXPIRED ITEMS DISPOSED OF DURING INSPECTION. Paris Baguette (Inspection Date: 10/15/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: OBSERVED NONE OF THE TCS ITEMS HELD ON TIME IN DISPLAY CASE (INCLUDING RED BEAN BUN, CHEESECAKE TARTS) TO BE LABELED WITH END TIME.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. CDI: PRODUCTS LABELED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED LARVAL COCKROACH ON THE FLOOR IN THE KITCHEN. PIC STATED THEY ARE SERVICED ONCE A MONTH.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PLEASE GET A PEST CONTROL SERVICE TREATING FOR COCKROACHES BY OCTOBER 25TH. MOVING FORWARD, YOU MUST GET PEST CONTROL EVERY TWO WEEKS DUE TO COCKROACH LIFE STAGE LENGTH. PROVIDE ME WITH THE INVOICE BY OCTOBER 25TH.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED (10) AT 48F AND HOLDING TCS FOODS AT 51-54F. OBSERVED (8) AT 43F AND HOLDING TCS FOODS AT 46F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PLEASE GET COOLERS SERVICED TO HOLD TCS FOOD AT 41F OR BELOW BY OCTOBER 25TH. DO NOT STORE ANY TCS FOODS IN THEM UNTIL THEY ARE WORKING AS REQUIRED. PROVIDE ME WITH AN INVOICE AND PROOF OF BOTH COOLERS HOLDING FOOD AT 41F OR BELOW BY OCTOBER 25TH.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED UNAPPROVED SPLITTER ON THE MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. CDI: SPLITTER REMOVED. APPROVED DEVICE SPECIFICATIONS WILL BE PROVIDED OVER EMAIL.

violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. Pic disposed fo spray can of RAID

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: open front display cooler
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PIC replaced thermometer in the open front cooler
